method: v1_overlap.py lists every v1 gold sharing an article, law, number (whole-word), parenthesised Spanish term or tema with the row; every listed v1 gold on the same tema or with a non-numeric hit was read in full against the row's key rule(s). Criterion (amendment 10): no v2 key rule stated anywhere in any v1 gold.
decided_by: orchestrator (Claude Opus 5.5), 2026-09-23, before the round-2 review

V2-M1-03.reason: tracto abreviado + ISD-before-registration not stated in any v1 gold (hits were '29/1987' in a usufruct gold and 'art. 335' LEC)

V2-M1-05.reason: ownership-without-possession / no self-help not stated; hits were 'entrega de posesión' and 'first-occupancy'

V2-M2-05.reason: late-payment interest cap not stated; v1 M2-05 is TIN vs TAE

V2-M3-03.reason: 10-day e-notification and appeal deadlines not stated; v1 M3-04 shares only art. 30 month-counting as a side point

V2-M5-05.reason: no v1 row on M5:T43; Ley 6/2020 absent from v1 golds

V2-M1-01.reason: exceso de cabida ≤10% (art. 201.3 LH) not stated; M3-03 mentions Ley 13/2015 coordination only

V2-M1-04.reason: auction reserve 75% / 50% award / purge of subsequent charges not stated; only numeric noise

V2-M2-01.reason: LCCI acceleration thresholds (12/3%, 15/7%) not stated; M2-02 covers fee caps and partial repayment only

V2-M2-02.reason: ERL (Ley 14/2013) not stated; M2-08 covers SL/SA capital and IAE

V2-M2-03.reason: M2-04: 'la lámina ... envejece y filtra, conviene comprobar su antigüedad antes de comprar' = this row's first key rule

V2-M3-01.reason: Water Act 5 m / 100 m zones not stated; M3-02's 'en ríos puede reducirse a 20 m' is the Coastal Act protection easement

V2-M3-02.reason: surface right, reversion without compensation, 99 years not stated

V2-M3-04.reason: Estudio de Detalle limits not stated; no candidates

V2-M3-05.reason: conservation duty capped at 50% / ruina not stated; M3-06 mentions conservation works for fuera de ordenación only

V2-M4-01.reason: M4-02: 'Druga i kolejna sprzedaż budynku jest zwolniona z VAT i podlega ITP (art. 20.Uno.22 LIVA)' = the rule the headline rests on

V2-M4-02.reason: M4-07: 'La cancelación de hipoteca está exenta de AJD' = this row's key rule

V2-M4-03.reason: tasa vs ICIO, ICIO base and 4% cap not stated; 'icio' hits were substrings (servicio, beneficio)

V2-M4-04.reason: optional IBI reliefs not stated; M4-05 covers accrual and apportionment

V2-M5-01.reason: headline (CEE for any rental, 4-month threshold gone) is new, but the question's second half is answered by M3-10/M5-08's in-person visit within 3 months and 'advertiser displays the rating'

V2-M5-03.reason: consumer definition + vulnerable consumer + business buyer is not a consumer are not stated; M5-03 cites arts. 3-4 TRLGDCU only as the condition that the SELLER be a trader (shared citation noted)

V2-M5-04.reason: M5-01: colegiados 'are covered by the Colegio's collective professional civil-liability insurance (art. 11 RD 1294/2007)... no collective insurance behind' a non-API = this row's decisive content

V2-M6-01.reason: cost build-up 1.20 × CEM / 1.38 not stated; delete the closing clause 'the cost method values only the building, the land value coming from the comparison or residual method' (M6-09 side point)

V2-M6-02.reason: valor de repercusión / valor unitario not stated; M6-05 notes buildability ≠ plot surface only

V2-M6-03.reason: ECO market-value definition excluding taxes and marketing costs not stated

V2-M6-04.reason: method not applicable without a representative market, and never mixing built/usable m² in one sample, are not stated; M6-02's step '(3) wybór reprezentatywnej próbki' is a procedure step, noted

V2-M6-05.reason: negative F = not viable and i = risk-free + premium raised with leverage not stated; delete the leverage-effect clause 'because the land only receives what is left over ... disproportionate swings in F' (M6-05 side point)

V2-M2-03.reason: scale reading 1:500 + trapezoid area not stated; M2-01 is útil vs construida; numeric hits are noise

V2-M4-01.reason: IS special regime for residential-letting entities (85% relief, arts. 48-52 LIS) not stated; M2-09 cites LIS only for depreciation coefficients; '85' hit is art. 85 LIRPF

V2-M4-02.reason: dwelling leases VAT-exempt (art. 20.Uno.23 LIVA) not stated; M4-02 states the different art. 20.Uno.22 second-supply rule (shared citation family noted)

V2-M5-01.reason: office video surveillance (art. 22 LOPDGDD: sign, 1-month retention) not stated in any M5:T40 gold

V2-M5-04.reason: visado colegial not automatic (art. 13 Ley 2/1974) not stated; M5-09 shares Ley 2/1974 and the 2009 Ómnibus reform for the different art. 14 fee-scale rule
